clusters.title: NSE’s debut far quieter than IPO frenzy
clusters.description: Shares of National Stock Exchange (NSE) jumped more than 5% after making a muted Dalal Street debut on Thursday, with brokerages issuing bullish calls and target prices implying up to 22% upside potential.NSE shares listed at Rs 1,800 apiece on BSE. This marks 0.8% premium over its IPO price of Rs 1,785 apiece, missing grey market estimates. The company’s market capitalisation at the time of debut stood at around Rs 4.45 lakh crore.In less than an hour since the muted market debut, NSE shares jumped more than 5% from IPO price to hit a high of Rs 1,878 apiece. The sharp gains added around Rs 19,290 crore to the stock exchange’s market capitalisation, pushing it up to Rs 4.64 lakh crore.
